newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Two of Venezuela's CVG companies lose $1.9 bln/yr.
newsitem.headline: Two of Venezuela's CVG companies lose $1.9 bln/yr.

text.p: Two of the companies in Venezuela's state-owned holding company Corporacion Venezolano de Guyana (CVG), due to be privatised early next year, lose some $1.9 billion per year, Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff said.

The resources lost by steel maker Sidor and aluminium company Alcasa "could be spent instead on better health systems, education and other public services," Petkoff told a conference of CVG technicians, according to a Planning ministry press release.
Venezuela's resource-rich Guyana region should "be at the vanguard of economic growth and employment generation," he said.
The sell-off of the CVG's iron and aluminium arms is expected to bring in some $5 billion in sale proceeds next year.
